articles.body:
IGN's Cyberpunk 2077 Guide and Walkthrough will lead you through every life path and major choice, along with strategies for all boss encounters, unlocking all endings, and much more. This Cyberpunk 2077 walkthrough guide has been verified for the Cyberpunk 2.0 update .

Looking for something in particular? Click the links below to jump to...

There are 41 main missions in Cyberpunk 2077's base story, split between a prologue, three acts, and an epilogue. Due to the diverging epilogues, you won't be able to play every quest on a single character (unless you reload your save file, technically).

The first few missions focus on setting up V via one of three Life Paths - Nomad, Street Kid, or Corpo - and a quick job to introduce you to Jackie and Night City.

The first act focuses on setting up the heist that the entire story hinges on. You get the tools for the job in The Pickup and gather more leads in The Information, which you can tackle in either order.

The second act is by far the largest chapter of the story, seeing you complete three main questlines - Panam's, Judy's, and Takemura's. Once again, these sections can be done in any order, and finish with Tapeworm, which leads you into the final proper act.

Act 3 is where you'll decide on your ending and is where playthroughs differ most (outside of the epilogue). You'll only be given the missions that relate to your choice during Nocturne Op55N1, so pay attention and check out our guide to the Cyberpunk 2077 endings to learn more.

Once again, depending on your choices in Act 3, you'll get a different epilogue mission. These are very short and mostly just require you to listen and pick a few dialogue options.

Not sure which ending is best? Click the links below to learn everything you need to know about each of the seven different endings that are available to choose from.

Returning to Night City as cyber-enhanced mercenary V, you'll embark on a high-stakes mission of espionage as you attempt to save Myers -- former CEO of Militech and current NUS President -- who has crash-landed in the dangerous district of Dogtown while traveling on the Space Force One. Ruled by a trigger-happy militia, Dogtown will test your limits as you'll be forced to forge alliances within a web of shattered loyalties and sinister political machinations.

With failure not an option when working as a government secret agent, V must work with a star-studded cast to unravel the secrets of Phantom Liberty, all while facing some of Night City's most intimidating and dangerous enemies.

Not sure how to start Phantom Liberty or get to Dogtown? Check out the guides below:

For more information, click the links below to jump to a specific Phantom Liberty Main Job walkthrough guide.

Cyberpunk 2077 Phantom Liberty expansion contains many different endings you can unlock depending on your dialogue choices during key moments in the story.

This section of our guide will explain each possible ending in the game, including how to get them and their secret outcome counterparts.

Looking for even more Cyberpunk 2077 Guides ? Why not check out...

If you'd like to learn more about the writers and editors who contributed to this wiki, head to our About IGN's Cyberpunk 2077 Guide Writers page .

articles.summary: Much of your time playing through Disney Dreamlight Valley will be focused on Quests provided by the various characters that you'll encounter throughout
articles.body:
Much of your time playing through Disney Dreamlight Valley will be focused on Quests provided by the various characters that you'll encounter throughout the Valley. This Disney Dreamlight Valley Walkthrough will provide comprehensive guides for all available Quests, including introduction quests, main story quests, and individual character quests.

If you'd like to learn more about the writers and editors who contributed to this wiki, head to our About IGN's Disney Dreamlight Valley Guide Writers page .

Disney Dreamlight Valley Walkthrough Guides

Need help with a particular Quest? Continue scrolling below to find a complete list of all quests, or click the handy links below to jump to our individual character quest guides.

Certain quests at the very beginning of your journey are tailored to help acclimatize you to the various gameplay mechanics and loops within Dreamlight Valley. This hub page breaks off into individual walkthroughs, which will help you can complete them.

Your favorite dog in a turtle neck, Goofy, provides plenty of fun opportunities from day one of your game.

Mickey Mouse, the face of Disney, is a mainstay in your village and has some really interesting questlines revolving around his partner, Minnie.

The duck with the mountain of money, Scrooge McDuck has a wide array of missions for you, mainly revolving around making money and cleaning up the valley.

The wizard in the valley, and the first character you'll encounter, Merlin acts as a guiding hand through the early hours, and helps you open the valley to even more friends.

The shy little robot that could, WALL-E has a tonne of objectives centered around friendship and gardening, and sometimes both!

The headstrong princess of Motunui, Moana loves to explore and provides opportunities for you to also do so.

The demigod with an ego, Maui, ignorantly has a number of quests where you help keep him happy... but maybe he does secretly appreciate it.

The little rat with a penchant for cooking, Remy brings a delicious deluge of quests for you.

The devious denizen of the seas joins your village, but is there an ulterior motive to the missions she provides?

The ice-born guy with a heart of gold, Kristoff has plenty of jobs to keep you busy!

This squeaky hothead storms into the valley with a fury, and keeps you on your toes as you progress his questline.

The witch of a woman with ulterior motives hides out in the Glades, but what is her goal? What will she make you do?

The innocent mermaid who longs to be part of your world wants nothing more than to bond with you and the other villagers. Help her to do that!

The loyal partner to Mickey, Minnie is a headstrong girl with a lot of heart, and helps to brighten the valley to no end.

The courageous and independent sister of Elsa, Anna looks out for her sister at every turn.

The ice-powered queen flurries into the valley and brings with her a sense of true power and humility. Help her keep her distance, and try to warm her heart.

The windswept Prince saved by a mermaid, Eric is ready to make a splash in your village once he's freed from Ursula's curse.

The second-born Prince of the Pride Lands and the brother of the late king, Mufasa, Scar is one of Disney's most infamous villains and can be found in the Sunlit Plateau region.

First discovered when visiting the Toy Story Realm, Buzz Lightyear requires your assistance for a top-secret mission to rescue his best friend, Woody, who has fallen out the window of Bonnie's Room.

Discovered after first helping Buzz Lightyear in the Toy Story Realm, you'll need to help Woody rebuild Bonnie's toy farm to replicate her drawings.

Hidden away within a multi-part quest that spans ten days, you'll discover Stitch , our loveable blue alien friend, has finally made his way to Dreamlight Valley. Work together with your friends to solve the mystery of the missing socks and ultimately help bring Stitch back home to the Valley.

The Festival of Friendship Update added the lovable and huggable snowman Olaf to Disney Dreamlight Valley . Work together with Olaf to restore the Orb of Power to Frosted Heights and to officially welcome him to the Valley.

The Festival of Friendship Update added the optimistic and empathetic member of Family Madrigal Mirabel to Disney Dreamlight Valley . Work to bring Mirabel back to the Valley and throw a Festival of Friendship.

The Pride of the Valley Update added the cheerful and righteous Nala to Disney Dreamlight Valley . Unlock Nala through The Lion King Realm and bring the Here and There Fish to the Valley.

The Pride of the Valley Update brings the newly appointed leader Simba to Disney Dreamlight Valley . How to unlock Simba will occur after unlocking Nala through The Lion King Realm. Simba's quests bring the Dreamlight Trees back to the Valley.

The Remembering Update brings Cinderella's Fairy Godmother. Though, in Disney Dreamlight Valley 's case, she is the Fairy Godmother of all of the Villagers and helps grant wishes. How to Unlock the Fairy Godmother will occur from the Forgotten Lands. The Fairy Godmother's quests bring players closer to tackling the game's main story events.

High-speed but ultra-sweet racer Vanellope von Schweetz from Wreck-it Ralph was introduced as part of Disney Dreamlight Valley's DreamSnaps update . She introduces players to the DreamSnaps mechanic , where they can compete against other Dreamlight Valley denizens to create gorgeous photo scenes.

The Enchanted Adventure update to Disney Dreamlight Valley brings with it Belle, the bookish princess from the Disney classic Beauty and the Beast. Players can convince Belle to journey from the Beauty and the Beast Realm to make her home in Dreamlight Valley alongside her beloved Beast.

The Beast is initially a little reluctant to leave his Realm and move to Dreamlight Valley, as he's worried people will be frightened by his intimidating appearance. However, as you play through the Enchanted Adventure update , you can help the Beast get settled. You can even unlock the Beast's Greenhouse, a new location to Forage for flowers including the brand-new Red Roses!

The Forgotten once ruled Dreamlight Valley, but they were turned to the dark side, causing the event known as the Forgetting to occur. By completing the Story Quests for the Fairy Godmother and Merlin added as part of The Remembering update , you can redeem the Forgotten and invite them to return to the Valley where they once lived.

Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King, travels from the world of holiday magic to Disney Dreamlight Valley during the "Pumpkin King Returns" update. He wants to bring his festive frights to the Valley!

Added as part of the Laugh Floor update, Monsters, Inc.'s Mike Wazowski wants to bring a touch of Monstropolis culture as well as his signature Jokester humor to Dreamlight Valley!

Taking a vacation from his duties as CEO of Monsters, Inc., James P. "Sulley" Sullivan has now put his efforts towards improving life in Dreamlight Valley. As you progress through Sulley's Quest line, you'll arrange fun events, pick the Village of the Month, and more!

After spending some time away investigating The Forgetting, Daisy Duck is finally ready to come back to Disney Dreamlight Valley and reunite with all her friends.

First, Mulan needs some help keeping her Realm safe from the Huns. Then, once she returns to Dreamlight Valley, she wants to keep up her training regime and get other Villagers involved too!

Mushu, like Mulan, starts out in the Mulan Realm with a series of Realm Quests to complete. After he moves to the Valley, Mushu takes on his Guardian duties and begins doing what he can to keep the Villagers safe and happy!

After spending some time trapped inside a cookbook, Tiana is ready to get down to work and return back to Dreamlight Valley.

One of Simba's best buddies, Timon the meerkat has arrived to spread his "no worries" philosophy in Dreamlight Valley! He and Pumbaa kick off the epic "Infestation" storyline in which Night Mites invade the Valley.

Simba's other best friend, laid-back Pumbaa greets his new life in Dreamlight Valley with his and Timon's signature phrase: "hakuna matata!" As one of the top bug catchers around, Pumbaa is involved in clearing out Night Mites in the "Infestation" storyline.

Jack Skellington's partner, this lovely rag doll from Halloween Town brings some of her signature spooky energy to the Valley in the form of gardening, quilting, potion-making and more!

The street rat who found a magic lamp, Aladdin comes from his Realm to the Village, bringing with him stealthy adventures!

Jasmine is the princess of Agrabah, and she will do anything to keep her beloved city safe. In Dreamlight Valley, she helps you discover a magical Journal from your past!

Alice is a curious little girl who you first meet in the Alice in Wonderland Realm. Once you have helped her find her way back from Wonderland, she helps you investigate a rather unusual Kaleidoscope!

The Cheshire Cat is a tricky feline from Wonderland who loves nothing more than making mayhem. After completing a series of Quests to unlock him, he brings his trademark Wonderland nonsense to the Valley!

The leader of the Lost Boys has been trapped inside Skull Rock since The Forgetting, but he is finally free! Help him recruit some new Lost Boys and fight pirates in Dreamlight Valley.

Joy is a cheerful emotion form the Inside Out films. She joins the Valley and helps you recover the pieces of a strange plush bear alongside her fellow emotion Sadness!

The gloomy Sadness comes from the Inside Out films, and she joins the Valley alongside Joy. Complete her and Joy's Friendship Quests to explore a memory from your past that you have been concealing!

The charismatic candlestick Lumiere joins Dreamlight Valley alongside Cogsworth from Disney's animated movie, Beauty and the Beast. Complete Lumiere's Friendship Quests to uncover more about a ghostly mystery!

Cogsworth is the dutiful clock from Disney's animated movie Beauty and the Beast. He joins the Valley alongside his comrade and candelabra friend, Lumiere. Complete Cogsworth's Friendship Quests to help him settle into the Valley, albeit with a few troubles along the way!

Cinderella is a classic Disney Princess with a challenging quest list. She is a late-game character that requires many previous villagers to already be present before many of her quests can be started. Below is everything you need to tackle Cinderella's Friendship Quests in Disney Dreamlight Valley.

Lady is a lovely and elegant dog who lives with her owners Jim Dear and Darling before falling in love with the wild Tramp. In Disney Dreamlight Valley, she has not only Friendship Quests to complete but also special Quests related to the Hidden Mementos!

Tramp was a free-roamin' pup before falling in love with Lady. In Disney Dreamlight Valley, you can recreate the pair's iconic spaghetti date, help Tramp befriend various Villagers, and even sniff up lost treasure together with this adventurous pooch!

Pocahontas is an adventurous and kind character who has a strong connection with the natural world. In Dreamlight Valley, you get to help Pocahontas prepare for the Celestial Celebration and Moontide Glow, help rescue her beloved raccoon friend Meeko, and restore some friendship bonds in the Valley!

Hercules is a kind and valiant hero who joins Dreamlight Valley in the ' A Hero's Journey ' update with this trainer, Phil. Help Hercules fix a prized possession, get to the bottom of a strange, fishy mystery, and more!

Phil is a charismatic and legendary hero trainer who joins the Valley in the ' A Hero's Journey ' update with Hercules. Help Phil put on a play, be a hero coach, and much more in his Friendship Quests and complete his Realm Quests before welcoming him and Hercules to the Valley!

Wreck-it Ralph, the arcade baddie with a huge heart, finds his way to Dreamlight Valley in the Pixel Perfect update ! After helping The Forgotten free him from a strange arcade machine , you can help Ralph host a Bad-Anon meeting, play mini-games with him, and channel your inner Fix-it Felix in Ralph's Friendship Quests!

Oogie Boogie is a trickster who loves to bring terror to Halloween Town. In Disney Dreamlight Valley's Season of Scares update , you learn he was trapped in a mirror, and must be unlocked via a series of six spooky Quests ! These Quests involve visiting Oogie Boogie's sinister Lair and playing all sorts of spooky games with the Boogieman himself.

Important PSA for Unlocking Oogie Boogie

If you want to unlock Oogie Boogie in 2026, you MUST begin his first Quest, A Halloween Invasion , no later than November 4, 2026. Once you have begun the first Quest, the other five can be completed at any time once they have unlocked.

As long as you have STARTED A Halloween Invasion, you will be able to unlock Oogie Boogie, even if you finish up the Quest chain after November 4.

If you missed out on Oogie Boogie in 2026, he will return to the Valley in October 2027 !

The following characters are only available as part of Disney Dreamlight Valley's " A Rift in Time " expansion.

The tricky Royal Vizier is added to Disney Dreamlight Valley as part of the " A Rift in Time " expansion. He has a sneaky scheme up his sleeve - can you stop it in time?

This princess from Tangled is one of the characters added during the " A Rift in Time " expansion. She is finally free from the tower where Mother Gothel kept her, and is eager to explore everything the world has to offer!

Confident, cocky Gaston is discovered stranded on Eternity Isle during the " A Rift in Time " expansion. His Quests center around introducing the "Gastonian" way of life and searching for a new sidekick to replace LeFou.

EVE, WALL-E's robot friend, was responsible for guarding the Royal Hourglass on Eternity Isle, encountered as part of the " A Rift in Time " expansion. Now, she's looking for a new directive in life, and needs you to help her!

Oswald the Lucky Rabbit is one of the first characters ever created by Disney. He comes to the " A Rift in Time " expansion of Disney Dreamlight Valley as part of its " Spark of Imagination " update, and is introduced during Act II of the expansion's story before moving onto Eternity Isle permanently.

The following characters and quests are available as part of the Storybook Vale expansion.

This fiery Scottish princess is the first resident of Storybook Vale you will meet. She serves as keeper of the Bind area and will be one of your primary allies throughout the expansion's story.

Flynn Rider has become separated from Rapunzel and resides in Storybook Vale. This roguish adventurer has been cursed by Maleficent to believe that he is a wolf, and you will need to break the spell before you can get to know him better.

The God of the Underworld from Hercules, Hades sees Storybook Vale as a place where he can finally become the powerful ruler he wants to be, free from Zeus's authority. He's not always the most helpful ally, but he IS always ready with a humorous quip!

Calling herself the Mistress of All Evil, Maleficent has set herself up as the ruler of Storybook Vale, and has come into conflict with Hades as a result. Her dark magic has caused the spread of ink-themed damage throughout the region.

In order to reach Maleficent's castle and Hades' residence on Mount Olympus, you will need to complete three Fairy Tale Trials and three Mythic Trials, in which you will re-create various classic tales.

The seemingly benevolent guardian of all stories in the Storybook Vale, there is more to this talking book than meets the eye. In addition to keeping all the Tapestry Puzzles within her pages, the Lorekeeper has several quests in Part 2 of the Storybook Vale expansion.

Aurora, the title character from Sleeping Beauty, is the last character that you unlock in the Storybook Vale. She wants to do everything she can to help out around the Vale, from throwing a party to stopping Maleficent and Hades' evil plans in their tracks!

The following Quests are available as part of Disney Dreanlight Valley's Wishblossom Ranch expansion :

Snow White, the classic princess from Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, is a resident of Wishblossom Ranch, which is mysteriously falling apart. Snow White needs your help to restore the lands and find the missing horses.

Cruella de Vil, from the 101 Dalmatians franchise, lives in the fashionable Glamour Gulch region of the Wishblossom Mountains. She likes to give orders and has plenty of errands for you to help with as you work towards solving the ongoing mystery of the Wishblossom Heart.

Tinker Bell is the tiny fairy from Peter Pan who is having some trouble with Pixie Dust in the Wishblossom Mountains. Before you can unlock Tinker Bell as a character during her first Friendship Quest, it's up to you to help her get things back to normal in The Decay and several Crystal Cavern Story Quests, including rescuing all horses.

Tigger is the friendly and energetic fictional tiger from Winnie the Pooh who you meet in the Pixie Acres region of the Wishblossom Ranch Expansion. While Tigger seems to have some trouble with giant trees, missing balloons, and words, he puts together some inventive games for you to play before unlocking him as a character!

The following Quests are available as part of Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods expansion:

The first character you will meet in the Honeyglow Woods is everyone's favorite honey-loving bear, Winnie the Pooh! Pooh needs your help to find his missing friends, Piglet and Eeyore, and solve the mystery of why the Woods have become covered in fog!

Eeyore lives in the Gloommeadow, the second area of Honeyglow Woods you will unlock. He'll need you to help out with a variety of problems, such as finding his lost tail and repairing his broken-down House!

The small but mighty Piglet can be found in Braveheart Grove, the third area of Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods. Help Piglet care for his friends and the world around him as he restores the Grove, prepares for a rainy day, starts a Critter club, and more!

All Secret Potato Quest Walkthrough Guides

Hidden within the Valley are secret quests that involve finding colored potatoes. Finding all secret colored potatoes will reward you with a rainbow companion!

Need help obtaining a particular color potato in Disney Dreamlight Valley? The following secret potato walkthroughs detail all the necessary steps needed to complete all six secret quests that are hidden across Disney Dreamlight Valley.

To learn more, check out our comprehensive walkthroughs below or watch our handy secret potato video guides to learn more about these tricky quests:

Unlocking the Secret Potato Quests Reward

Completed all the secret potato quests above? Here are the next steps to completing the mysterious quests, which will see you unlocking a brand-new rainbow fox companion.

articles.title: The 11 Longest Video Game Stories of All Time
articles.summary: The longest video game stories include multiple Persona and Monster Hunter games, as well as a surprising first-party entry from PlayStation.
articles.body:
Ever-improving technological capabilities have led to ever-expanding possibilities in game development, and over the past two decades especially, studios have harnessed those technologies to make their games look better, play smoother, and for the most part, run longer .

Game length has become a critical selling point given consumers' limited time and money, and their seemingly unlimited options for entertainment. So, with the help of IGN sister site HowLongtoBeat , we set out to discover the longest video game campaigns ever made.

The list is based on the average time it takes to ‘mainline’ a game's campaign (i.e., to play straight through the story without exploring much or any side content). We decided to highlight story length rather than overall length as the overall list is dominated by idle games and neverending simulations. HowLongtoBeat estimates are based on user-reported playtimes.

See also : our list of the longest-running video game franchises of all time.

My Time at Portia, a cozy town simulator from 2019, squeezes onto our list with a 70.5-hour campaign — half an hour longer than Crusader Kings 3.

My Time at Portia offers nearly as much content outside of the main story, as completionists can expect to spend around 135 hours with the sim.

This list is dominated by two franchises: Monster Hunter and Persona. The latter’s first entry on this list is the PS2 game Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4, which rolls credits around 72.5 hours .

Persona 4 Golden, now available on modern platforms, is described as an “expanded” version of P4, though according to HLTB, it has a shorter average completion time of 68 hours. However, Golden has a longer estimated time for completionists at 139 hours.

The first of four Monster Hunter games on this list, Monster Hunter 3 Ultimate clocks in at 75 hours . Ultimate is an expanded version of the Wii-exclusive Monster Hunter 3.

While credits roll after roughly 75 hours, completionists can expect to spend 553 hours with MH3U.

Pathfinder: Kingmaker, a video game adaptation of the popular tabletop RPG, earned a spot on this list with a 77.5-hour campaign.

Completionists can expect to spend 198 hours with the isometric RPG.

Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate is another sprawling action-RPG from Capcom. Its 77.5-hour runtime is tied with Pathfinder: Kingmaker’s, though MH4U gets the edge given its greater length for completionists: 387 hours to Pathfinder’s 198.

6. Dragon Quest 7: Fragments of the Forgotten Past

Dragon Quest 7, the longest entry in Square Enix’s 37-year-old JRPG series, clocks in at 78 hours . The seventh Dragon Quest game came West in 2001 as Dragon Warrior 7 before a 2013 3DS remake adopted its original Japanese title.

Completionists can expect to spend 159 hours with the JRPG.

Sony’s PS2 racer Gran Turismo 4 featured a 78.5-hour career mode — 30 hours longer than any other entry in the series, according to HLTB. For reference, the recent Gran Turismo 7 campaign mode, GT Café, takes roughly 24 hours to complete. Gran Turismo 4 is the only first-party game on this list from Sony, Microsoft, or Nintendo.

Completionists can expect to spend 279 hours with Gran Turismo 4.

Capcom one-upped itself again with Monster Hunter Generations Ultimate, a massive action-RPG with a 79-hour runtime . First released in Japan as Monster Hunter XX, Ultimate is a beefed-up Switch version of Monster Hunter Generations for 3DS. For comparison, the original release had an average completion time of 54 hours.

Completionists can expect to spend 689 hours with Monster Hunter Generations Ultimate — more time than any other game on this list.

Persona 3’s main story wraps after 82 hours , good for third place on the list of all-time longest video game campaigns. An extended version of P3, Persona 3 FES, was released a year later, though according to HLTB, that can be completed in two fewer hours.

However, Persona 3 FES does feature more overall content than the base version: Completionists can expect to spend 140 hours with the JRPG.

At 98 hours long, Monster Hunter Freedom Unite is the longest Capcom campaign and the second-longest game on our list. First released in Japan as Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G, Unite is an extended version of Monster Hunter Freedom 2.

While credits roll around the 98-hour mark, Monster Hunter Freedom Unite has roughly 459 hours of content for completionists.

The longest single-player story in gaming can be found within Atlus’s preeminent JRPG Persona 5 Royal. HLTB lists the average completion time for its story at 101 hours . Royal, like many games on this list, is an extended version of a previously released game.

In addition to having the longest story, Persona 5 Royal has one of gaming's best: It earned a review score of 10 from IGN and a spot on our list of the best modern RPGs .

Considering the statistics for both Persona 5 and Persona 5 Royal, completionists can expect to spend 143–173 hours with the JRPG. It's currently the longest game in the Persona series unless the upcoming Persona 6 can dethrone it.

Jordan covers games, shows, and movies as a freelance writer for IGN.

articles.title: Vehicle Contract Missions - Cyberpunk 2077 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: As you explore the new district of Dogtown in Cyberpunk 2077's Phantom Liberty DLC, you'll be able to take part in new, repeatable Vehicle Contract
articles.body:
As you explore the new district of Dogtown in Cyberpunk 2077's Phantom Liberty DLC, you'll be able to take part in new, repeatable Vehicle Contract missions . This guide will explain how to unlock and begin Vehicle Contract missions, the various optional objectives you'll encounter, as well as the potential rewards you can expect from each one upon completion.

Click or tap any of the links below to jump to a specific section:

In order to unlock the repeatable Vehicle Contract missions from Muamar, you'll need to first complete the Side Job titled Push it to the Limit , which can be acquired by encountering a car marked for a Vehicle Contract for the first time.

Upon completion, you'll be able to take on Vehicle Contract missions for the Fixer whenever you see the blue steering wheel icon displayed on your minimap.

How to Complete Vehicle Contract Missions

Just like Push it to the Limit, Vehicle Contract missions can be started by hopping into marked vehicles on your minimap. Each subsequent mission is titled Just Another Story .

Your goal is simple: you’ll need to find the marked vehicle and drive it to the designated Fixer’s location as indicated by Muamar. Enemies and the NCPD may try to pursue you, so do your best to eliminate or outrun them before arriving at your destination.

Sometimes, Muamar will give you an optional objective that requires you to do something in addition to delivering the vehicle.

Chase - Enemy vehicles will spawn throughout your delivery and attempt to destroy the vehicle.

Time Limit - You'll be required to deliver the vehicle within a predetermined time limit.

No Damage - This one is easier said than done, but you'll need to avoid major vehicle damage and deliver it in one (relatively unscathed) piece.

Hacking - You'll need to hack the vehicle first before you're able to jump in and drive.

While these objectives are optional, they will net you additional rewards if you are able to complete the additional request.

Once the vehicle has been safely delivered, you’ll be granted access to a cache that contains a random assortment of the following items:

Completing the Vehicle Contract's optional objective will net you an additional random selection of Tier 5 rewards as well.

Completing Vehicle Contracts will also allow you to purchase new and rare vehicles from the Autofixer netpage terminals that can be found around the city. Each Vehicle Contract mission completion will net you a stacking discount that can be used to save big on a vehicle of your choice. However, once you purchase a vehicle, the discount is reset and you’ll need to complete additional Vehicle Contracts to gain future discounts.

articles.title: The Best Halloween Movies to Watch With Family
articles.summary: From Hocus Pocus to Halloweentown, these are the best Halloween movies.
articles.body:
Halloween is a holiday that often gets attached to iconic slashers like Michael Myers and Freddy Krueger, but there are many horror films out there for the whole family. October is for all types of frights, including the softest gateway introductions to young-adult streets toward fear. Everyone deserves to explore the darkness, no matter the age. Let's take a look at some of the best Halloween movies to watch with your loved ones, whether they like to keep things spooky or prefer their haunts on the softer side.

And when you're done here, be sure to check out our picks for the best Halloween TV episodes too!

Is James and the Giant Peach a horror film? Roald Dahl’s writing has always had a bit of a dark bend, which certainly makes its way into Henry Selick’s stop-motion feature. Can we argue against the gigantic mechanical shark, the aunts with insecticide, or the nightmare rhino? It’s certainly nothing more than gateway horror that gently introduces young viewers to some terrifying elements that could be entirely worse, but works as an entry point nonetheless. Not everyone wants to start with Freddy or Jason – sometimes machine sharks are enough of a thrill.

I love how Hocus Pocus has ties to both Child’s Play (David Kirschner) and Critters (Mick Garris) franchises — the Disney Halloween staple with story credit from the minds of genre madmen. Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, and Kathy Najimy can now boast their Sanderson sisters are decades-spanning witchy icons with the newly released Hocus Pocus 2 . While the sequel does pale a bit in comparison, you better believe I got all tingly when the sisters reappeared and dove right into a musical reintroduction number. There’s so much kid-friendly Halloween spirit, from magical books with eyeballs to spellcasting to lavish costumes on these 17th-century Salem queens. Hate all you want, but the Sandersons aren’t going anywhere and this is one of the best Witch movies .

Disney’s Halloweentown is the kind of kid-friendly gateway horror that’s cushier than your child’s favorite plush animal. Kids ride a bus stop to a secret place where it’s always Halloween, and monsters come home from a long day of scaring humans. Frankensteins and Gremlins complain about how there’s scarier stuff on Jerry Springer, while skeleton taxi drivers tell awful spooky puns. Everything is meant to ease children into horror like a warm hug, from masks you’d find at Spirit Halloween to the uplifting and light tone throughout the films. Halloweentown is about celebrating the spirit of Halloween, which it does pretty well for young audiences.

What’s this? A Christmas horror movie on a Halloween movie list? Henry Selick makes another appearance with his stop-motion collision between Halloween and Christmas, featuring a Skellington who refuses to stay stuck within his spooky Holiday realm. As Jack Skellington (voiced by Chris Sarandon, with help from Danny Elfman for musical numbers) explores the wonders of Santa’s duties, we get a heavy dose of holiday crossover that doesn’t negate either. From oogie boogies to — no shock — fabulous stop-motion designs, Nightmare Before Christmas is a timeless classic that dares to dream outside typical October boxes now filled with presents that bite back.

Rob Letterman’s Goosebumps adaptation is one of the better gateway horror films in recent memory, emphasizing family entertainment over outright chills — but it’s plenty good at the former. Jack Black is a hoot as R.L. Stine and the voice of Slappy, as teens must capture all of Stine’s Goosebumps monsters released from their pages. From giant mantises to werewolves to other famous Goosebumps creatures, Letterman oversees a story that incorporates them with such seasonal glee. It’s the perfect pre-teen monster mash, which still works on adults because Black’s comedy talents (citing Orson Welles as inspiration) span generations — a feel-good winner with so much Goosebumps love.

Joel Schumacher’s The Lost Boys is so much movie. Blood can’t just be red liquid; it’s laced with glitter to sparkle like gaudy disco Halloween decor. Vampires can’t just be bloodsuckers; they’re dirt-bike riding, boardwalk menaces with leather jackets and mullets. A cast including Kiefer Sutherland, Corey Feldman, Alex Winter, Corey Haim, and more are going all-in on the over-the-topness of a Schumacher production, which is primarily why the film’s legacy has endured. From the Chinese take-out scene to dangling off bridges over fog clouds, The Lost Boys oozes style and attitude that’s so infectiously 80s. They honestly don’t make ‘em like this anymore.

For me, there’s no better Laika tale than ParaNorman. What a magnificent tale of life, death, zombies, and family. It’s an ode to the outcasts that references everything from Halloween to Manos: The Hands Of Fate. It’s a gateway horror film made by hardcore genre appreciators that doesn’t dilute storytelling for younger audiences but still appropriately holds hands. Laika’s stop-motion talents are displayed as monsters and ghouls invade Blithe Hollow, exceptionally crafted down to the tiniest undead appendage. The kind of introductory horror that assures audiences there’s warmth and a beating heart available in the otherwise stereotyped genre, but not without plenty of bumps in the night.

Over three films, Leigh Janiak ties together a slasher that honors the 90s, 70s/80s, and 1660s, all with distinct period elements. 1994 delivers raw Scream vibes, 1978 gets back to Friday the 13th basics, and 1666 ushers in the season of the witch. A strong cast, tremendous kills, and all-out supernatural warfare make Netflix’s trilogy a can’t-miss horror event that executes its concept — and characters — so well. I’m a 1994 lover, but that’s the glory of Janiak’s films. As much as I adore 1994, there’s still much to enjoy in the other two entries. What’s your favorite?

Tim Burton's Beetlejuice drips with gothic extravagance that's been immortalized by Hot Topic because it's so irresistible. Michael Keaton stars as the striped-suited, green-haired spirit hired to drive humans out of their home, which becomes an onslaught of haunted mischief. From extra-dimensional worm creatures to shrimp cocktail hands or Alec Baldwin and Geena Davis' outstretched facial forms, Beetlejuice spares no expense honoring freakshow imaginations. Some scenes might rattle the youngins, but nothing bad enough to send them screaming. It's top-notch Burton, staying as weird as ever.

Alright, Henry Selick — leave some selections for other directors! Although, you can’t talk about Halloween titles for the whole family without including the Neil Gaiman adaptation Coraline. A young girl finds a door to an idealized version of her home life, where her parents appear more attentive and caring…at a price. When the button-eyed versions of mommy and daddy prove to be more sinister doppelgangers than perceived, Coraline learns the dangers of escaping reality for the fantasies we dream. Selick once more tells a heartfelt childhood tale that gets supremely spooky in “Other World,” but never enough to frighten youngsters. Another heartstrings tugger, as Selick’s been known to create.

Chances are your childhood was haunted by the illustrations for Alvin Schwartz’s Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark books. Well, André Øvredal does a pretty stellar job bringing ghouls like Jangly Man and Pale Lady to life on screen in the movie adaptation. It’s one of those gateway horror films that’s of a more advanced level, when Nightmare Before Christmas turns from creepy to only fun. Øvredal doesn’t hold back when endangering children with haunted tales pulled from Schwartz’s source material, complete with crawlies bursting out of wounds and big toes in food. Don’t let the PG-13 rating fool you; Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark brings the scary.

Remember when Eddie Murphy starred in that early 2000s Disney movie about its Haunted Mansion attraction? Murphy plays a realtor whose summoned alongside his family to a mansion, which turns out – as per the film's title – to be haunted. It's said the film is inspired mainly by Disney Paris' Phantom Manor, which features a clearer storyline about a bride, her lost lover, and the hauntings that follow. Disney fanatics will recognize the ride's staples, from singing busts to dancing ballroom spirits to the ride's narration of "Welcome, foolish mortals." While it's not exactly beloved, it's still a spooky choice for the family to enjoy together that gets the Halloween vibes flowing — it's Eddie Murphy doing his "dad with lessons to learn" schtick, after all.

The Ghostbusters have experienced quite the pop-culture run, starting with 1984's original and continuing as recently as Ghostbusters: Afterlife — which will expand its canon with an upcoming video game. Venkman, Stantz, Spengler, and Zeddemore exist in ghost-hunting infamy. From megaton marshmallow mascots to pink ooze rivers — without mentioning cartoon spinoffs and other media appearances — make the series a Halloween staple that the whole family can enjoy (sans some lewd humor). There's so much to appreciate between Slimer's antics and the killer ghost designs — as long as the levitating librarian doesn't give you nightmares like this author!

Fred Dekker’s The Monster Squad can be credited with many a novice horror fan’s first introductions, where they learned to fear and love their favorite villains. Classic creatures from Dracula to Gillman square off against young monster fanatics who must protect their hometown from their greatest obsession. They’ll learn lessons about friendship and Wolfman anatomy — they do, indeed, have nards — like any 80s adventure riff like The Goonies. It’s packed with horror reverence and storytelling love, bordering on slapstick with great creature effects. It’s got everything any horror newbie could ask for, ready to show audiences everything that scary movies have to offer. All that with an 80s coat of paint? The Monster Squad is an essential horror starting point.

Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman play witchy women who make midnight margaritas and search for love despite prejudice against their kind. Broomsticks and levitation strengthen the bonds of sisterhood as Bullock and Kidman have a blast using their powers. It’s mostly a sunshiny take on being better than our ancestors until some exorcism thrills occur in the film’s latter half. Otherwise, expect something sweeter, less diabolical, and to be shared by covens at sleepovers as watchers giddily kick their feet in the air.

Tim Burton makes another appearance with the stop-motion Frankenweenie, a story about a boy and his undead dog. It’s more gateway horror for the lil’ ones, but does well as a Frankenstein riff about overcoming grief and dealing with loss. The dubbed “Frankenweenie” is resurrected because he’s missed, which becomes a story about moving on instead of trying to change the past. Or? It’s just a sweet-and-silly homage to old Hollywood horror about loving pets, monster science experiments, and letting the past stay dead but not forgotten.

Has there ever been better casting than Anjelica Huston as Morticia Addams and Raul Julia as Gomez Addams? The first Addams Family live-action film is dripping with macabre, as Christopher Lloyd poses as Uncle Fester in an attempt to steal Addams treasure. It’s filled with cemeteries, severed hands, and all the decadently gothic touches that made the Addams family so famous in the first place, bringing a delightful authenticity to Barry Sonnenfeld’s big-screen adaptation. It screams “Halloween” in presentation alone and brings all the creepy and kooky vibes horror fans crave — a true October treat.

Whichever version of The Witches you watch, have some fun. You're better served by the original 90s film starring Anjelica Huston that has way more grotesque-but-gorgeous fun with practical effects, although Anne Hathaway is having a blast in the remake. It's more of that gateway vibe about entry witchcraft content, with a darker bend based on Roald Dahl's literature. Children have had it coming for a while — let The Witches fulfill a momentary catharsis as witchy women enact their sinister-but-playful plans.

Take a look at our guide to the best witch movies of all time for more like this.

Scooby-Doo has been delighting families as an animated character for decades, but that’s not at a loss in years. There are fan favorites like Scooby-Doo! and the Witch’s Ghost or Scooby-Doo on Zombie Island, but also a host of other subgenre explorations around the horror genre. Scooby-Doo and the Cyber Chase does digital terror, Scooby-Doo! Moon Monster Madness goes to space, and Scooby-Doo! WrestleMania Mystery features multiple WWE stars. Break out the Scooby Snacks and settle in for a marathon if you’ve got the time because there’s plenty of Scooby-Doo love to go around.

In yet another collaboration between Tim Burton, Johnny Depp, and Helena Bonham Carter, a wedding is shared by the living and the dead. It's Burton's first foray into stop-motion, which he co-directs with Mike Johnson. There's a lot of Victorian gothic charm that feels reminiscent of The Nightmare Before Christmas, down to the underworld aesthetic of the Land of the Dead. You can still find plenty of Carter's revenant "Emily" in Spencer's and Hot Topic shops as a testament to its pop culture standing – maybe not on the level of Jack Skellington, but still prolific enough for a reason.

Remember this gateway horror mummy rom-com? Or, I don’t know, maybe centuries-old meet cute? Teenagers join forces with a mummy out of his element to engage in risky adventures, trying to reunite the mummy with his lover from over 4,000 years ago. It’s not particularly high-brow or revolutionary, but why not. It’s Halloween and you’ve got little ones around — you can do infinitely better, but also astoundingly worse. Wacky mummy hijinks ensue as goofballs try to help their dusty friend find love, it’s a tale as old as time.

Looking for something scarier to watch? Take a look at our guides to the best horor movies of all time or the best slasher movies ever .

articles.title: Want To Smell Like a Werwulf? This Perfume Has You Covered
articles.body:
Nothing says date night like the smell of "the heat of flesh that was once human." Robert Eggers' Werwulf hits movie theaters at Christmas, but you can pre-order an official perfume set based on the movie right now. Focus Features has teamed up with the very fancy Heretic Parfum for a set of three very specific fragrances.

Designed to represent each stage of a werewolf transformation, the descriptions of each of the scents are a wild ride.

The Wode Hath Teth: The scent of the feral woodland itself. Cold bark, frozen soil, and smoke in the air. Resinous. Mineral. Austere.

Werwulf: The transformation. Skin, damp earth, root, resin, and the suggestion of wet fur. Intimate. Warm. Primal.

Blodwode: The memory of what the forest has witnessed. Bleeding tree bark, leather, musk, and the heat of flesh that was once human. Animalic. Resinous. Untamed.

The set is limited edition, $55, and won't ship until at least November 6, but at least that's in time for Grandma's Christmas present. You can also grab each perfume individually for $125.

It's not the first movie collaboration Heretic has done. Nosferatu Eau de Macabre used notes of "wilting lilacs, velvety vegan ambergris and strikes of lightning" while one for the The Bride promised "Jasmine and rose stitched together as flesh. Cedarwood as bone. Frankincense as breath or spirit." The company is perhaps most notorious for creating the viral “This Smells Like My Vagina” candle with Gwyneth Paltrow in 2020.

Rachel Weber is the Head of Editorial Development at IGN and an elder millennial. She's been a professional nerd since 2006 when she got her start on Official PlayStation Magazine in the UK, and has since worked for GamesIndustry.Biz, Rolling Stone and GamesRadar. She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.

articles.title: Tech layoffs 2026: Tracking the job losses across Microsoft, Netflix, Electronic Arts, eBay, Apple, Meta and others
articles.summary: There are only a couple of months left of the year and there have been over 195,000 layoffs across the tech industry. Here are the details.
articles.body:
We've only got a couple months left in 2026, but unfortunately we didn't get here without a ton of tech layoffs. In June, 14,000 job cuts happened at EV automaker Lucid, game developer Bungie, trading platform company Robinhood and others. Microsoft 's round of layoffs in July affected 4,800 jobs — mostly across its Xbox gaming division. Shortly after, companies including Samsung, Amazon, Uber and Monday.com followed suit.

According to many reports , the U.S. is at the center of these job cuts. Oracle has had the biggest impact on layoffs this year so far. The annual financial disclosure the company filed on June 23 showed the software giant cut 21,000 jobs over the past year, roughly 13% of its workforce.

"The adoption and deployment of AI technologies across our operations have resulted, and may continue to result, in reductions to our workforce," Oracle said in the filing.

In response to the numerous job cuts, California Governor Gavin Newsom in June unveiled a tool to track AI's impact on the workforce . "As AI advances, we aren't just watching from the sidelines; we're reimagining how we prepare California through strong governance and innovative policy." In addition, more than 4,500 Google workers signed a petition calling for layoff protections as things get worse. Some of the protections they're asking for include buyouts before mandatory layoffs and guaranteed severance.

TrueUp finds that layoffs seem to be moving at a faster rate than last year — over 245,000 workers in tech were let go in 2025, while there have been more than 195,000 layoffs in 2026 so far. Several of the companies below have laid off employees due to increased spending in AI. We'll get into the reasons for the layoffs.

While not officially new layoffs just yet, reports claim Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees. This is in an effort to further reduce costs in the wake of increased AI usage. According to the reports, Xbox, Windows, Copilot and finance divisions will be participating in the offer. Microsoft already laid off thousands of workers so far in 2026.

EBay will reportedly cut 9% of its workforce in an effort to streamline operations. The latest job cuts come after a previous round of layoffs back in February, which affected about 800 positions. "As we work to capture the significant opportunity ahead, this step was taken to ensure we continue to operate from a position of strength by aligning our teams and resources with our top strategic priorities," an eBay spokesperson said in a statement.

Vide game publisher EA will eliminate 400 jobs , or about 3% of its workforce. This includes shutting down BioWare , the development studio behind the Mass Effect games. The next Mass Effect title will be cancelled as a result of the layoffs. These job cuts come after EA told investors earlier this year that it would reduce research and development costs as part of a plan to save upwards of $700 million.

According to a report in The Wall Street Journal, Netflix will lay off about 1,000 people, which accounts for about 6% of its global workforce. The report says the bulk of the layoffs will affect Netflix's "product, tech, legal and human-resources teams." This latest round of layoffs is the biggest for the company sinsce 2022, and it comes in the wake of Netflix struggling to increase customer engagement and overall growth.

A "large part" of the Airtable team was laid off on October 12. Federico Simionato, Airtable owner Bending Spoons' product leader, said on X that the layoffs were not due to the workers' abilities but rather the company's "deep belief that small teams ship more and better." The exact number of employees affected by the layoffs wasn't disclosed.

Amazon has reportedly laid off "fewer than 1,000 white-collar workers" in its stores division. That's the part of the company that oversees the tech giant's e-commerce website. Employees in the U.S., India and the United Kingdom were reportedly affected.

Workday will be laying off around 140 employees from the Bay Area, as part of an effort to trim its tech team. The cuts come as part of a broader plan to cut the company's global workforce by 2.5%.

Xbox announced it eliminated 268 roles across Halo Studios, other first-party studios and additional areas of the Xbox Game Studios division. These layoffs are part of a "reset" it announced this summer; the company already laid off 1,600 people in July, and said at the time that an additional 1,600 terminations were still to come.

According to a Bloomberg report , Apple has laid off an undisclosed number of employees from Fitness+, the company's exercise subscription service. According to the report, the layoffs affected those who worked in the audio side of the division, which includes features like Time to Walk and Time to Run guided audio workouts. Reportedly, offerings like this will be reduced — but not eliminated completely — from the service.

Oracle employees were impacted by yet another round of layoffs in September. The total number of employees laid off this time around is not currently known. The tech giant reportedly set employees early morning emails on Monday, September 14, letting those affected know it would be their last working day. It's also reported that, with these layoffs, Oracle is looking to offset the amount of money is pouring into AI chips and data centers. Earlier this year, Oracle laid off 21,000 people.

Uber announced it will cut 3,300 jobs, or about 10% of its workforce, in a big restructuring effort. "We are removing layers, simplifying team structures, refining our global location strategy, and focusing our people and investments against the biggest opportunities ahead of us," CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said in a statement . While the cuts apply to both regular employees and managers, the company stated it will reduce the "number of employees who sit 7+ layers from the CEO" by 20%, and it will cut the number of "micro-teams" by almost 50%. The CEO's memo did not mention AI as catalyst for the layoffs, but it did explain that this restructuring will allow Uber to bring its services to more people, invest in more drivers and merchants and "build the autonomous future."

According to an AppleInsider report , Apple laid off at least 60 people in its Vision Group, which is the team responsible for the Vision Pro VR headset. A Bloomberg report notes that Apple is also laying off roles in its Intelligent Systems Experience group, which is partially responsible for some of the AI systems on Apple devices. Overall, its estimated the layoffs affect more than 200 people.

When it comes to Vision Group and Vision Pro, it's been reported that incoming CEO John Ternus would be putting that product category "on ice," so this seems like the start of that process. The Vision Pro headset came out in 2024 with an eye-watering $3,699 starting price, and it remains to be seen if Apple will be pulling out of the AR/VR category entirely in the future. The Intelligence Systems changes are reportedly tied to changes that are necessary for the technical architecture for Apple's newly AI-infused Siri.

The New York Times reported that TikTok will lay off 250 people and close its Nashville, Tennessee office in October. This location was home to, in part, some of TikTok's content moderation team, although the company has not specified the reason for the layoffs or which teams they primarily affect. "We have decided to close our Nashville office to streamline our operations and better align our teams for long-term growth," a press officer for what is known as the TikTok U.S.D.S. Joint Venture said in a statement to the Times.

Zillow will lay off just over 500 people as it enacts organizational changes across the company. "These are difficult decisions that reflect both the strides we're making in our strategy and the reality of what is required of us to grow at scale," CEO Jeremy Wacksman wrote in a press release . Wacksman didn't go into detail about what organizational changes were made, or which departments are bearing the brunt of the layoffs. "These changes are about ensuring we have a disciplined cost structure and getting more efficient, with the right people in the right positions," he wrote.

Etsy laid off about 220 people, or 12% of its workforce, as it attempts to simplify its organizational structure. The cuts primarily affected the product and engineering teams, and Etsy CEO Kruti Patel Goyal said that the layoffs were necessary to build "the organization we believe Etsy needs for the future." An Etsy spokesperson told CNBC that the cuts were not driven by artificial intelligence adoption.

Microsoft has begun another round of layoffs that affects 4,800 jobs , or around 2.1% of its workforce. The Xbox division is getting hit the hardest, with 3,200 roles getting cut through fiscal year 2027, Xbox chief Asha Sharma said in a post on X — 1,600 people were let go on July 6. Shortly after those layoffs were revealed, it was announced that Sharma was appointed to a U.S. Federal Reserve task force to help advise it on "productivity and jobs." Other appointees include Marc Andreessen of Andreessen Horowitz and Charles I. Jones, professor of economics at Stanford University.

Intel is reportedly downsizing its data center group, despite strong performance. The company hasn't disclosed how many roles would be affected.

Visa will be cutting about 2,600 jobs, which amounts to about 7% of its workforce. The layoffs will primarily affect the technology and product teams, and the impetus in part is to make the company more efficient. "To capture the opportunities ahead and best position Visa to lead this transformation, we must continue evolving how we work," Chief Executive Officer Ryan McInerney wrote in a memo. "AI is also helping to accelerate this evolution and shape the way work gets done at Visa." But according to Bloomberg's report, AI was not the only factor to influence Visa's decision to do these layoffs. The company reportedly intends to reinvest in things like consumer payments and value-added services like stablecoin.

Software company Monday.com will be laying off 20% of its workforce, which comes out to about 630 people. This comes as the company makes a pivot to AI and is attempting to make its AI platform a core offering of its business. Earlier this year, it designed its main product around the idea that business customers increasingly want its employees to work with AI agents.

Patreon laid off 20% of its workforce, or 93 people, as a result of the company "changing our organizational structure and how we work." But Patreon was explicit in its email to creators and staff that "we are not making the above changes because we believe AI replaces humans." However, the email also said "AI has fundamentally transformed the tech industry, though, including how we work."

Uber has reportedly laid off 10% of its customer service division, according to a Bloomberg report, as it looks to "embrace artificial intelligence" and simplify its ranks. The company also stated in May that it would slow hiring as it makes use of AI more internally.

Samsung is eliminating 179 jobs as it moves its New Jersey headquarters to Texas later this year. The move is expected to impact around 1,000 workers. We're now getting a fuller picture of what that looks like: according to Reuters , 739 roles at Samsung's New Jersey location have been affected in some way. Some have been offered relocation packages as the company shifts its headquarters to Texas, while others have been let go. In addition, it's reported that 100 roles in its Texas location, primarily in the mobile division, have also been let go.

Amazon will lay off some people in its artificial general intelligence group, although the company has not disclosed how many roles will be affected. "This is a fast-moving space, and we're sharpening our focus on the initiatives that matter most for customers, so we can move faster on what counts," an Amazon spokesperson told CNBC.

Sony Interactive Entertainment released a statement that it's cutting "a significant number of employees" from its Bungie workforce. That includes most of the Destiny team and some Marathon team members, as well as SIE teams that support Bungie's operations. The email didn't say how many employees were affected.

Electric vehicle maker Lucid announced it's cutting around 18% of its workforce, and also noted COO Marc Winterhoff's leaving the company, Reuters reported . The layoffs are in an effort to "​boost profitability amid growing competition." The cuts affect full-time employees, contractors and hourly manufacturing workers.

Cloud computing services company Rackspace laid off 750 workers , or around 15% of its workforce. The cuts are driven by a shift in focus toward AI.

EV company Rivian let go of hundreds of employees , which amounts to around 2% of the company's workforce, the Wall Street Journal reported . Those affected were part of Rivian's service and customer organization, which handled marketing and sales.

Trading platform company Robinhood is planning to lay off 10% of its staff to restructure, the Robinhood Comms account shared on X today — that's around 290 jobs. It's unclear if the layoffs are AI-related, but CEO Vlad Tenev noted the company will be "utilizing frontier technologies to push our execution even further."

Salesforce laid off at least 86 employees in California, though Business Insider sources say job cuts also occurred in Washington and outside the U.S. as well. The cuts reportedly affect employees involved with Salesforce's Agentforce AI product, Mulesoft IT integration tool and its Marketing Cloud software.

Groupon is planning to lay off roughly 25% of its workforce , which will result in 400 job cuts. Those positions are expected to be eliminated by the end of the third quarter. This is in an effort to restructure the company and rebuild it as an AI-native company.

In another set of AI-related layoffs, website builder Wix said it was cutting around 20% of staff. Wix cofounder and CEO Avishai Abrahami announced the cuts on X , pointing to the changes AI is bringing to the industry and stating "we need to become a faster, leaner, and flatter organization." He also put part of the blame on the Israeli Shekel to U.S. Dollar exchange rates, which impact the company because it's based in Israel. The cuts are expected to impact around 1,000 roles, based on Wix's headcount.

Webflow, a website builder and hosting company, conducted a round of layoffs that an employee called "a bloodbath" in a statement to the San Francisco Chronicle . It's unclear how many employees were impacted, but one anonymous developer from the company told the Chronicle they believe it was larger than Webflow's last major round of layoffs, which affected 8% of its workforce in 2024. As with other recent layoffs, it looks like a shift to AI is to blame here. "AI is rewriting the rules for how marketing teams create, test, and optimize digital experiences," CEO Linda Tong said in a statement . "And the companies that move decisively through moments like this are the ones that come out ahead."

ClickUp CEO Zeb Evans announced that the company cut 22% of its workforce as it turns toward AI to improve productivity. He claimed it "wasn't about cutting costs," but about funneling savings from the cuts "directly back into the people who stay." The company has introduced million-dollar salary bands reserved for employees who "create outsized impact using AI."

Intuit is planning to lay off 3,000 employees, or about 17% of its workforce, Reuters reports . CEO Sasan Goodarzi sent a memo to employees noting the layoffs would help the company's efforts of focusing on infusing AI across its services.

Meta has officially begun cutting 10% of its workforce , totaling around 8,000 employees. In addition, it plans to close 6,000 open roles. The reason is to allow more room for AI spending.

Like Microsoft, NPR is offering voluntary buyouts to 300 employees in the newsroom, but only 30 will be accepted. However, if the news organization doesn't receive its target number, it will result in targeted layoffs. The reason is due to the loss of federal funding.

The online retail giant cut more jobs this month, this time from the Selling Partner Services organization. These new layoffs come after Amazon cut roughly 30,000 jobs in rounds across October and January. A spokesperson told Business Insider that the most recent layoffs have affected a "small number" of employees. The Selling Partner Services team works with third-party merchants on Amazon, providing onboarding, logistics and account management support.

Cisco is cutting just under 4,000 jobs in Q4, CEO Chuck Robbins said in a blog post . Impacted employees will receive pro-rated payment of 2026 bonuses and will also receive "support in finding new opportunities" via Cisco's placement services. In June, it was confirmed that the layoffs include 471 workers in the Bay Area .

"While we are reducing roles in some areas, we are making clear, strategic investments — particularly in silicon, optics, security, and in our employees' use of AI across the company," Robbins said.

LinkedIn is planning to lay off 5% of its staff, which is around 875 employees, Reuters reports . An anonymous person told Reuters the reason is to reorganize teams and focus employees on areas ⁠where its business is growing. However, one of the sources said the reason was "not for artificial intelligence to replace jobs at LinkedIn."

GM is letting go of around 500 to 600 employees in the Information Technology sector, Bloomberg reports . The reason is to "trim costs and clear the way to bring in staff with skills in other technology areas."

Due to restructuring driven by AI, Cloudflare is cutting more than 1,100 employees . "Today's actions are not a cost-cutting exercise or an assessment of individuals' performance; They are about Cloudflare defining how a world-class, high-growth company operates and creates value in the agentic AI era," Prince and President Michelle Zatlyn said in an email to employees .

PayPal is planning to cut around 20% of its staff — nearly 4,800 employees — over the next few years, according to the Wall Street Journal . "First, we will remove duplication and layers from our organizational structure. Second, we will accelerate our AI adoption and automation across our operations," CEO Enrique Lores said to investors.

Cryptocurrency platform Coinbase is laying off 700 employees , which amounts to around 14% of its staff. CEO Brian Armstrong cites the current market and AI changing the way they work as reasons for the layoffs.

Microsoft is offering a first-ever buyout to up to 7% of its employees, CNBC reports . It's a one-time retirement program that's available for workers at the senior director level and below whose years of employment and age are 70 or higher.

Nike announced it's laying off 1,400 people this week. "Collectively, these changes will result in a reduction of approximately 1,400 roles in global operations, with the majority in technology," COO Venkatesh Alagirisamy said. "These reductions are very hard for the teammates directly affected and for the teams around them, too."

Amazon is planning to temporarily close a warehouse in Homestead, Florida, which will eliminate more than 600 jobs, Newsweek reports . The job cuts will start in July and continue through September but the giant company is giving employees the option to relocate to other facilities. The warehouse has only been open for just under two years but Amazon is already looking to update the site.

Battery recycling company Redwood Materials laid off 10% of its employees, totaling 135 people, TechCrunch reports . Those who were let go received an email from the chief HR officer telling them the layoffs were made "to sharpen our focus, our work and the size of our teams to support the direction Redwood is going in the future."

Snap is laying off 1,000 workers , which is 16% of its staff, Variety reports . The Snapchat parent company made the announcement just weeks after Irenic Capital Management asked the company to make changes to improve performance and revenue.

Snap is using AI to streamline operations and assist the now smaller workforce. "We have already witnessed small squads leveraging AI tools to drive meaningful progress across several important initiatives," Snap CEO Evan Spiegel said.

Just two months after taking over as CEO of Disney, Josh D'Amaro announced the company is laying off 1,000 of its employees, AP News reports . In addition, Marvel let 8% of its staff go after the call was made.

"Over the past several months, we have looked at ways in which we can streamline our operations in various parts of the company to ensure we deliver the world-class creativity and innovation our fans value and expect from Disney," D'Amaro said in a memo to employees. "Given the fast-moving pace of our industries, this requires us to constantly assess how to foster a more agile and technologically-enabled workforce to meet tomorrow's needs."

The wearable camera maker this year will eliminate 145 employees due to a restructuring plan to cut costs, the Wall Street Journal reported . The cuts are expected to last until the end of the year.

Vimeo is going through its third round of layoffs since it was acquired by Bending Spoons. This time, the company let go of more than 120 people, which is about 25% of its city staff .

It's been reported that 200 Meta employees in the Bay Area will lose their jobs at the end of May. That includes 124 employees in Burlingame and 74 in Sunnyvale. The company last laid off workers just a few weeks ago.

Oracle has begun implementing a big cull of its employee base . On the final day of March, more than a dozen Oracle employees announced on LinkedIn they had been let go from their jobs, Business Insider reports . It's unclear at this time how many workers were affected, but it was projected to be thousands at the start of this month.

Those laid off received the same email : "After careful consideration of Oracle's current business needs, we have made the decision to eliminate your role as part of a broader organizational change."

The job cuts are reportedly to help Oracle stem a cash drain related its expenditures on AI infrastructure. In June, Oracle revealed that it had laid off 21,000 people as part of the cuts.

Deux Ex studio Eidos-Montréal announced on March 30 that it's laying off 124 people . In response, the studio head David Anfossi has decided to leave the company.

The cuts are a result of "changing project needs and impacts across production and support teams," the gaming company said in a LinkedIn post . It also noted that the decision to lay off these employees is not related to their talent or performance.

After already having layoffs in January , T-Mobile has cut even more of its workers, GeekWire reports . It's unclear how many people were laid off at this time, but it could be in the hundreds.

"To move even faster in a dynamic market while continuing to deliver best-in-class digital experiences for our customers, we're further aligning our IT organization to support future growth and innovation… This includes the difficult decision of eliminating some roles while continuing to invest and hire in areas," T-Mobile told GeekWire in a statement.

Meta began laying off hundreds of employees on March 25, totaling around 700 people, per The New York Times . Those impacted were part of the Reality Labs team, as well as social media and recruiting teams. Though still significant, this is a much smaller number compared to a Reuters report that suggested 20% off staff would be affected by layoffs due to the increased spending on AI.

This change comes as the company is shifting away from its metaverse creation, which includes Horizon Worlds for its Quest VR headset that's operated by the Reality Labs team.

The gaming giant on March 24 announced it was laying off more than 1,000 workers in an effort to right-size the staff of its popular free-to-play online shooter, Fortnite. CEO Tim Sweeney sent a note to his staff, citing the reason for the layoffs is due to the "downturn in Fortnite engagement," which means "we're spending significantly more than we're making, and we have to make major cuts to keep the company funded." He made it a point to note the layoffs are not related to AI.

105 employees from the Red Storm Entertainment team were laid off by Ubisoft in an effort to cut costs, IGN reports . Game development has ended at the studio, so the downsizing will remain permanent. The company employed 180 people in 2022 but has seen multiple layoffs over the years.

Roughly 1,600 employees were laid off at Atlassian on March 16, which is around 10% of total workers. Ahead of the layoffs, Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes shared a message with the entire team, letting them know the reason is to "self-fund further investment in AI and enterprise sales, while strengthening our financial profile. We're also changing the way we work and reorganising around our System of Work to move faster." Impacted employees received an email shortly after this message went out.

articles.title: The Sims 4 October 27 2026 Patch Notes - The Sims 4 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The October 27, 2026 Patch for The Sims 4 has arrived, bringing with it various additions, adjustments and fixes to improve game performance and overall
articles.body:
The October 27, 2026 Patch for The Sims 4 has arrived, bringing with it various additions, adjustments and fixes to improve game performance and overall stability.

This page acts as a comprehensive breakdown of the October 27 Patch for The Sims 4, including a link to the full Patch Notes.

Free Content - Classic Elder Looks & Cozy Nooks

This free content drop allows your older Sims to have a cozy, classic style just for them. The details are as follows:

Build Mode Items The Needlepoint Nook Chair (Armchair) Light of Yesteryear (Sconce) The Glowlden Goose (Table Light) Heritage Home Drapery Heritage Home Drapery - Wide Heritage Home Drapery - Extra Wide Petals & Proverbs Plaque The Floral Fossil (Sofa) Granny’s Roost Rug Bloom & Gingham Delight (Wallpaper) The Early Bird Bed (Double Bed)

CAS Items 2 New Hairs (Quiff Side Part, and Half-Down Waves) 4 New Assets Polo Shirt with Cardigan Long Dress with Lace and Buttons Sleeveless Blouse Long Skirt with Pockets 5 Recolors High Waisted Jacket Long Blazer Granny Dress Open Cardigan Loose Pants with Crease

2 New Hairs (Quiff Side Part, and Half-Down Waves)

4 New Assets Polo Shirt with Cardigan Long Dress with Lace and Buttons Sleeveless Blouse Long Skirt with Pockets

5 Recolors High Waisted Jacket Long Blazer Granny Dress Open Cardigan Loose Pants with Crease

Addressed an endless loading issue when placing lots that occurred due to excessive use of the Move Objects cheat. We updated the Navmesh (the thing that tells Sims where they can route or not) to be more robust to account for this. (Base Game)

Resolved an issue that caused an infinite white screen when attempting to load into certain affected save files. While some lot details in these saves may need a little rebuilding, you will now be able to safely jump back into your worlds and reunite with your households. (Base Game)

Sims are now able to properly Order Food or Drinks from Bartenders while they are doing something else like socializing, Practicing Tricks, or other Bartender behavior. (Base Game)

Getting bitten by a werewolf now properly transforms Fairy Sims into full-time werewolves without the black visual corruption.

Addressed an instance of Sims remaining frozen that could occur after a Sim took a nap or performed other interactions. (Base Game)

Fixed a case of visual corruption which could occur on an Active Sim during their Werewolf transformation after being bitten by another Werewolf. (Werewolves)

Addressed an issue where a new Infant Sim representing a Reborn Sim was not added to the selected existing Household or appearing in Create a Sim for customization. This Reborn Sim will now be able to successfully complete the Rebirth process. (Life & Death)

Fixed an issue that could cause Sims to get stuck and freeze while planning routing. (Base Game)

Infant Sims will now fall asleep properly without needing their Energy motive to be very low.

Based on feedback from Discord Dev Q&As, the devs have added New Game Options to Toggle On/Off Muscle and Weight changes for Sims holistically across a save + new self-interactions on Sims to Toggle On/Off these changes for Sims individually. These settings are completely independent of each other, meaning you can choose to keep weight changes active while turning muscle changes off, though please note that these options do not extend to pets like Cats & Dogs.

Sims should now autonomously prefer eating Leftovers (in the Fridge or on the counter) when they are hungry, rather than creating a new meal from scratch.

Moved the "Open" interaction to the front of the Pie Menu for Fridges.

Done a comprehensive tuning pass updating pricing and calories for all food and drink items across Base Game and all packs.

Added over 375 pre-existing dishes (many of them cultural dishes) to the valid recipe pool across Base Game and all packs.

Added a "Quickly Decorate" interaction on items made using the Baking Skill that uses a swipe animation when these baked goods are not located on the center of a counter top. Previously, Sims would route fail, and it wasn't entirely clear why. (Get to Work)

Sims are now more likely to stay seated when they are eating at a table. We fixed some multi-tasking issues around eating and conversations that were causing them to stand when they'd try to socialize while eating. There are still reasons why they might get up, but this experience should now be improved.

Sims will no longer put food in inappropriate places in general (this includes display cases). We made it so that dining tables and counter tops were the primary locations Sims wanted to put dishes.

Sims can now drag food that was prepared by another Sim into the fridge.

Sims should no longer autonomously use grills when it is snowy, rainy, icy, or storming. (Seasons)

Sims will no longer obsessively use the Pressure Cooker, which was resulting in them ignoring other food. (For Rent)

Addressed an issue where Sims would sometimes fail to show up for a Waiter shift at a Restaurant or where certain Customer Sims would not interact with Restaurant Employees. This was caused by some affected Employee Sims being special Sims with unique roles in other packs.

Dining customers should now want to socialize less before they are seated. This resulted in them talking extensively instead of being seated.

Fixed as many instances of Sims breaking flows and not properly dining as the devs could find.

Customers should no longer leave food uneaten or drinks undrunk at a Restaurant before they checkout.

Televisions are now able to be locked similarly to computers to ensure only certain Sims will use certain Televisions.

Moved all interactions that are considered "self-interactions" into a new "Sim Options..." category that can be accessed by clicking on the Sim that is actively selected.

Improved our Save Backup experience to calculate slightly differently.

If you wish to read the Patch Notes in full, you can do so via the official EA websites The Sims 4 October 27 Patch Notes post.
